contract.observation: Revision 2 was frozen before the corrected replay. Revision 1 remains physically preserved and is linked by the oracle-correction evidence.

initialObservations.finding: C02, C04, C06, D04, D06 and H05 did not isolate the intended successive observable root or valid seed; all 48 identifiers and eight families were retained in the corrected revision.

focusedReplay.coverage: The permanent matrix runs 48 frozen invalid candidates across eight six-case families, verifies exact diagnostic sequences and current locations at all five revisions, removes stale roots after repair, and checks a two-UTF-16-unit coordinate shift under repeated full analysis.

productionFindings.description: A two-space edit prefix retained the current diagnostic but reported its old span because the lexer trimmed the analyzed document before token spans were assigned.
productionFindings.repair: Lexer now retains the exact input string; its existing whitespace-token skipping keeps parsing behavior while token and diagnostic offsets remain in original document coordinates.

obligations.REC-124-O01: The 48 trajectories replay a valid seed, a first incomplete fault, a repaired seed with a different fault, a shifted reanalysis and a final repaired query.
obligations.REC-124-O02: The source-alias, projection-alias, CTE-output, derived-output, nested-scope and join families rename aliases or exported outputs one reference at a time.
obligations.REC-124-O03: Exact code and token assertions remove stale roots; the repeated-analysis method requires the retained root to shift by exactly two UTF-16 code units and remain stable on repetition.
obligations.REC-124-O04: The matrix uses repeated QueryAnalyzer.Analyze(string) calls; no editor or LSP integration is claimed because no incremental API is part of this target scope.
obligations.acceptance: All 48 frozen five-step trajectories pass with their expected outcomes and current source spans.

notes: Revision 1 contract, manifest and observation artifacts remain preserved; revision 2 corrected only observed candidate-construction defects before the final replay.

The first full-gate attempt is preserved under .campaign-artifacts/REC-124-full-gate-final and exposed one stale hard-coded evaluator span expectation after the lexer coordinate fix; the final gate passed after the fixture was updated to compute the consumer reference from the original query text.
The source and test payload was unchanged after the authoritative final gate; only evidence, report, ledger and progress administration follows it.
